steps.title: Meeting people
steps.text: In spoken Cantonese, 你好 (nei5 hou2) is the all-purpose hello. In the morning, people often say 早晨 (zou2 san4) instead.

steps.title: Polite closings
steps.text: 唔該 (m4 goi1) thanks someone for a favour or service. 多謝 (do1 ze6) is warmer — gifts, big favours, compliments. 拜拜 (baai1 baai3) is a casual bye.

steps.title: Clock numbers
steps.text: A clock has the numbers 1 to 12. Let's count in Cantonese: 一、二、三 … all the way to 十二!

steps.title: What is 點?
steps.text: Put 點 (dim2) after a number to say the hour. 三點 = three o'clock.

steps.title: Half past
steps.text: When the long hand points to 6, it is half past. Say the hour + 點 + 半: 三點半.

steps.prompt: 三點 + 半 = 三點半

steps.title: One 字 is five minutes
steps.text: On a Hong Kong clock, each number the long hand points to is one 字 (zi6) = 5 minutes. 一個字 = 5 minutes, 三個字 = 15 minutes.

units.title: Minutes
units.subtitle: 分 for exact times like 三點十分

steps.title: Minutes
steps.text: 分 (fan1) means minutes on the clock. Hour + 點 + minutes + 分: 三點十分 = 3:10.

steps.prompt: 點 + 分 → 三點十分
分鐘 = minutes (how long something takes).

steps.title: Ask the time
steps.text: Want to know the time? Ask: 而家幾點呀？ (What time is it now?)

steps.title: A whole day
steps.text: 朝早 morning → 中午 noon → 晏晝 afternoon → 夜晚 night.

steps.title: Before and after noon
steps.text: 上晝 is the morning part of the day (a.m.). 下晝 is after lunch (p.m.).

units.title: Yesterday, today, tomorrow
units.subtitle: 前日 · 尋日 · 今日 · 聽日 · 後日

steps.title: Day by day
steps.text: Think of a line: 前日 → 尋日 → 今日 → 聽日 → 後日. Today is in the middle!

steps.prompt: 尋日 = yesterday (you may also hear 琴日).
前日 = the day before yesterday
後日 = the day after tomorrow

units.title: Days of the week
units.subtitle: 星期一 to 星期日

lessons.title: 星期一 to 星期日

steps.title: Seven days
steps.text: 星期 means week. Add a number: 星期一 Monday … 星期六 Saturday. Sunday is special: 星期日!

steps.prompt: Sunday is 星期日 (not 星期七!)

steps.title: Twelve months
steps.text: 月 means month. Number + 月: 一月 January, 二月 February … 十二月 December.

steps.title: Early or late?
steps.text: 早 means early. 遲 means late. Look at the 鐘 (clock) so you are not 遲到!

steps.prompt: 遲到 = to be late (arrive late)
